issues.summary: REQ-033.md AC6's static grep for Math.random in apps/bot/src/domain/inviteCode.ts matches a code comment (line 25) rather than only executable code, so the spec's literal expected result (no output, exit 1) does not hold even though the actual CSPRNG-only property is satisfied (confirmed by reading the file and the passing vitest test).
